mode: One source-only HTTP counter plus owner readonly audit; no production implementation by auditor

normal_semantics: Build original relative->SHA map, verify configured receipt pins and process in order, overlay last accepted normalized relative, then verify final actual source SHA. Do not execute launcher during this audit.
owner_countercases: Windows drive-relative D:leaf and root-relative /leaf are not is_absolute but can escape the specified source root on join. Final owner helper rejects drive/root/parent parts and checks resolved containment.

An optional new_sha branch must not silently ignore a supplied typed candidate SHA. Final owner helper verifies complete typed candidate bytes/SHA and consistency, deriving missing SHA only from that verified pin.

Optional means key absent, not present with falsy value. Final owner helper validates declared source_root/target as nonempty strings and limits declared candidate shape; empty/false fields no longer fall through as absence.
adoption_grade: Three counterclasses derived by owner source review, actual helper edits by Runtime owner. Auditor wrote only private snapshots/review; final outside projection function raw bytes equal previous reviewed version.
